newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romanian Foreign Minister Adrian Severin met Prime Minister Gyula Horn and President Arpad Goncz in Budapest to exchange ratification documents of a basic treaty the two states signed in September.
Severin met his counterpart Laszlo Kovacs to discuss implementation of treaty provisions and the opening of several Hungarian consular offices in Romanian cities.
* Kovacs asked Romania to make the education law more flexible in order to allow ethnic Hungarians to use their mother tongue in schools at all the levels.
* Leaders of the ruling coalition met on Friday to finalise appointing local prefects.
* The government will hold a meeting on Saturday.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea summoned Bucharest city officials to take steps and solve traffic problems due to heavy snowfalls over the past days.
* Ciorbea said he will quit the job of Bucharest mayor in January when he will also present Bucharesters with the report on his 200-day rule. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
